newsitem.title: UK: UK cash grain markets see active trade.
newsitem.headline: UK cash grain markets see active trade.

text.p: UK cash grain markets were active on Wednesday with the delivered sector attracting most of the business.
Some traders said that at last farmers appeared have cracked and were selling while other said this was not the case.
"Now is the time for farmers to sell, because I can't see them getting better prices, but at the moment they are hanging on," said a trader.
On the fob market feed wheat traded at 92.50 stg for Feb, 93.50 stg for Mar and 95 stg for Apr/Jun fob east coast ports for 2,400 tonnes loads.
In East Anglia delivered feed wheat was trading from 93.50 down to 92 stg a tonne for Feb while new crop Oct/Dec traded at 95 stg a tonne.
On the south coast 93 stg was paid for Feb.
Feed barley traded at 95 stg for Jan and 96 stg for Feb in the Southampton area.
Traders reported no business in the milling wheat sector. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
